name: us6-zero-churn
description: US6 zero-churn idempotency (FR-030, SC-001). The spec already exists as a ticket (the plan context maps its local id to an issue key, so the plan is an UPDATE) and its current Jira fields exactly match what the bridge would write (the lifecycle context supplies them — the seam the discovery integration fills from a fail-closed read). The idempotency diff therefore drops the update: a real run (NOT dry-run) plans zero actions and performs zero Jira writes of any kind. Both ports emit a byte-identical empty action set and make zero mock calls (NFR-1).
